name: shinobi-arena
description: 3D ninja fighter, solo offline or online co-op/PvP for up to 6 players over Tailscale (Three.js + Rapier).

scripts.host: vite build && vite build --ssr server/main.ts --outDir dist-server && node dist-server/main.js
scripts.host:dev: vite build --ssr server/main.ts --outDir dist-server && (node dist-server/main.js --dev & vite)
